description: Shorthand for 26 biweekly pay periods ago — the single period at period_seq = -26.

phrases: authoritative snapshot;authoritative current snap;authoritative current snapshot
description: The snapshot taken on the period's own period_end_date (snap_dt equal to the period's ppe_dt).

phrases: new hire;new hires
description: An authoritative snapshot row whose new_hire_ind is 1. Counting a new hire in a window additionally requires hire_date in the window (see hire_date source).

phrases: hire date;date of hire;hired in;hire_dt
description: hire_dt is read from hr.employee_dim (system of record) for EVERY use — window checks, hire-vs-term comparisons, tenure ranking. The snapshot's own hire_dt reflects only what was known at that period's close and MUST NOT be used as the authoritative value.

phrases: term date;termination date;terminated on;term_dt
description: term_dt is read from hr.employee_dim for EVERY use. The snapshot's own term_dt reflects only what was known at that period's close.

phrases: active;active headcount;currently active
description: An authoritative snapshot row is active when status_cd = 'A'. NULL / 'L' / 'T' / 'R' / 'U' are NOT active.

phrases: on leave
description: An authoritative snapshot row is on leave when status_cd = 'L'. NULL status is unknown (not on leave); every other status is not on leave either.

phrases: not on leave;currently not on leave;NOT on leave
description: Every row where status_cd is NOT 'L', INCLUDING rows where status_cd is NULL.

phrases: voluntary;voluntarily;left voluntarily
description: A turnover row (turn_filt_ind=1) with invol_exit_ind = 0 is voluntary. invol_exit_ind is meaningful only on turnover rows; always check turn_filt_ind = 1.

phrases: involuntary;involuntarily;left involuntarily
description: A turnover row (turn_filt_ind=1) with invol_exit_ind = 1 is involuntary. invol_exit_ind is meaningful only on turnover rows; always check turn_filt_ind = 1.

phrases: unknown invol classification;unknown voluntary/involuntary;voluntary/involuntary classification is unknown
description: A turnover row (turn_filt_ind=1) with NULL invol_exit_ind is the UNKNOWN bucket — reported separately from voluntary and involuntary, and omitted from them.

phrases: Contractor;contractor;contractors
description: An associate whose employment type is 'Contractor'.

phrases: not a contractor;non-contractor;not contractors;NOT contractors
description: An associate whose employment type is anything other than 'Contractor', INCLUDING rows where assoc_type is NULL (unknown).

phrases: employment type
description: The associate's employment type is stored in the snapshot's assoc_type column. Values: 'FTE', 'Contractor', 'Intern' or NULL for unknown.

phrases: trailing {n}-period moving average;{n}-period moving average
sql: ROWS BETWEEN ({n}-1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

phrases: turnover row;leaver;leavers;left the organisation
description: A snapshot row that marks an exit event (turn_filt_ind = 1).

phrases: top {n} ranks;top {n} dense-ranks;top {n} dense ranks
description: The top N dense ranks: ties kept, no rank skipped.

phrases: soft-delete;deleted_at
description: Documentation only: this suite has no deleted_at column. A terminated associate (status_cd = 'T') is NOT a soft-delete and still appears on authoritative snapshots.

phrases: active person-periods;person-period;person periods
description: Documentation only: an authoritative-snap associate row across periods. Give it a sql to have it checked.

phrases: last {n_months} calendar months;past {n_months} calendar months;previous {n_months} calendar months;trailing {n_months} calendar months;most recent {n_months} calendar months;{n_months} most recent calendar months;over the last {n_months} calendar months;last {n_months} months;past {n_months} months;trailing {n_months} months;{n_months}-month calendar window;{n_months} calendar-month window
description: Documentation only (glossary has no calendar-month window definition; meaning taken from the registered gold of q035/q029). N calendar months anchored to the current biweekly pay-period end (pay_period_dim freq_cd = 'B', period_seq = 0, its ppe_dt = ppe_now): the month of ppe_now and the N-1 months before it. Window start = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(ppe_now, INTERVAL N-1 MONTH), MONTH); window end = ppe_now (the current month is partial, up to the pay-period end). One row per month_start = GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(window start, DATE_TRUNC(ppe_now, MONTH), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) - N rows. Not a pay-period window: do not translate to period_seq.

phrases: across the last {n_months_back} calendar months;across the past {n_months_back} calendar months;{n_months_back} calendar months back;{n_months_back} months back;going back {n_months_back} calendar months;going back {n_months_back} months;looking back {n_months_back} calendar months;looking back {n_months_back} months;spanning the last {n_months_back} calendar months
description: Documentation only, same meaning as last_n_calendar_months (calendar months anchored to the current biweekly pay-period end, i.e. the ppe_dt of the current biweekly period, window start = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(ppe_now, INTERVAL N-1 MONTH), MONTH), window end = ppe_now, N month rows) but bound to the slot n_months_back, the parameter name the q029 reference uses. Kept as a separate term only because one wording can bind one slot name.

phrases: month of hire;hire month;hire-date month;bucketed by hire month;by month of hire
description: Glossary event_month_bucketing: a new hire counted per calendar month falls in the month of hr.employee_dim.hire_dt (DATE_TRUNC(hire_dt, MONTH)), not the pay-period month of the snapshot row carrying new_hire_ind = 1. Each associate is counted exactly once in their event month.

phrases: month of termination;termination month;term month;term-date month;bucketed by termination month;by month of termination
description: Glossary event_month_bucketing: a voluntary leaver counted per calendar month falls in the month of hr.employee_dim.term_dt (DATE_TRUNC(term_dt, MONTH)), not the period_end_dt of the turnover row (turn_filt_ind = 1, invol_exit_ind = 0). Each associate is counted exactly once in their event month.

phrases: months with no activity;months with no qualifying;must appear with zero counts;must appear with zero;include months with zero;show empty months as zero;zero-filled months;empty months as zero;include empty months
description: Documentation only (glossary gap; from the q029/q035 gold). Every month of the calendar-month window is returned, from a generated month grid LEFT JOINed to the counts, with a count of 0 (IFNULL(..., 0)) where the month has no events.

phrases: set of segments;in-scope segments;segments in scope;segment scope
description: Documentation only (the glossary does not define segment). From the q029 gold: the distinct non-NULL emp_period_snapshot.segment values of active (status_cd = 'A') associates in my organisation on the authoritative snapshot at the current biweekly pay-period end.

phrases: pct_of_total;percent of the manager-scoped total;percent of the total;percentage of the total;share of the total;headcount share;share of headcount
description: Documentation only (glossary gap; from the q030 gold). A group's active count as a percent (0-100) of the manager-scoped total active count: active_n * 100 / SUM(active_n) over all groups, NULL-safe on a zero total (SAFE_DIVIDE / NULLIF); reported rounded to two decimals.

phrases: segment rank;segment_rank;segment ranking;rank of the segment
description: Documentation only (glossary gap; from the q030 gold). RANK() over active count descending, 1 = largest; tied segments share a rank and the next rank is skipped (not DENSE_RANK).

phrases: within {tolerance_pp} percentage points;within {tolerance_pp} percentage points of the leading segment;within {tolerance_pp} percentage points of the leader;within {tolerance_pp} percentage points of the top segment;within {tolerance_pp} percentage points of the largest segment;within {tolerance_pp} pp;within {tolerance_pp} pp of the leader;within {tolerance_pp} points of the leading segment;within {tolerance_pp} points of the leader;no more than {tolerance_pp} percentage points behind the leader;no more than {tolerance_pp} percentage points below the leading segment;at most {tolerance_pp} percentage points behind the leader;{tolerance_pp} percentage points or less behind the leader
description: Documentation only (glossary gap; from the q030 gold). Keep a group when its share in percent plus the tolerance is at least the largest share: pct + T >= MAX(pct) OVER () (inclusive; the leader itself always qualifies). Percentage points are absolute differences of percents (2 pp: 30% vs 32%), not a relative 2%. The BigQuery gold compares the unrounded share.

sql: lvl_2_id, lvl_3_id, lvl_4_id, lvl_5_id, lvl_6_id, lvl_7_id = {manager_id}
description: Documentation only. Glossary my_organisation: the reporting chain is emp_period_snapshot.lvl_2_id through lvl_7_id. Per q031, a decomposition by chain and level pivots these columns to (chain = 'reporting', lvl = 2..7) rows where the column equals the manager.

phrases: functional chain;functional hierarchy;functional line;functional-chain levels
sql: lvl_2_id_fn, lvl_3_id_fn, lvl_4_id_fn, lvl_5_id_fn, lvl_6_id_fn, lvl_7_id_fn = {manager_id}
description: Documentation only. Glossary my_organisation: the functional chain is emp_period_snapshot.lvl_2_id_fn through lvl_7_id_fn. Per q031, a decomposition by chain and level pivots these columns to (chain = 'functional', lvl = 2..7) rows where the column equals the manager; an associate counts in every (chain, lvl) bucket where the manager appears.

phrases: which hierarchy chain;hierarchy chain (reporting or functional);reporting or functional chain;by chain and level;by hierarchy chain and level;per chain and level;each chain and level;(chain, lvl) bucket;(chain, lvl) buckets
description: Documentation only (glossary my_organisation names the two chains; the decomposition is from the q031 gold). Split my organisation by where the manager appears: one bucket per (chain, lvl), chain 'reporting' for lvl_N_id and 'functional' for lvl_N_id_fn, lvl 2..7. An associate is counted (distinct) in every bucket whose column equals the manager, so bucket counts can sum to more than the organisation's headcount.

phrases: lvl_3 node;lvl_3 nodes;level 3 node;level 3 nodes;level-3 node;level-3 nodes
description: Documentation only. A node at reporting level 3: a distinct non-NULL emp_period_snapshot.lvl_3_id value (glossary my_organisation names lvl_3_id as a reporting-chain level).

description: Glossary top_dense_ranks and q033 ('ties kept via DENSE_RANK'): the top N nodes by an ordered measure keep every node whose dense rank is N or better, ties kept, no rank skipped.

phrases: capped at the {cap_n} newest;capped at {cap_n} newest;capped at the {cap_n} newest per node;limited to the {cap_n} newest;up to the {cap_n} newest;at most {cap_n} members per node;the {cap_n} newest hires per node;the {cap_n} most recent hires per node;{cap_n} newest members;{cap_n} most recently hired

ORDER BY hire_dt DESC, assoc_id LIMIT N)). 'Newest' = latest hire date, read from employee_dim (glossary authoritative_hire_and_term_dates).

phrases: {n_recent_periods} most recent pay-period ends;{n_recent_periods} most recent pay period ends;{n_recent_periods} latest pay-period ends;{n_recent_periods} most recent period ends;most recent {n_recent_periods} pay-period ends;latest {n_recent_periods} pay-period ends;last {n_recent_periods} pay-period ends;{n_recent_periods} most recent pay periods;most recent {n_recent_periods} pay periods;{n_recent_periods} latest pay periods
description: Glossary last_n_pay_periods: the N most recent biweekly pay periods are the window ending at the current one, period_seq -(N-1)..0 inclusive; their ends are those periods' ppe_dt.

description: Documentation only (the fallback is not in the glossary; from the q032 gold). N biweekly pay periods (glossary last_n_pay_periods: period_seq -(N-1)..0) ending at the current pay-period end, unless no active (status_cd = 'A') associate under the manager is on the authoritative snapshot at that end; then the window shifts back one period: period_seq -N..-1, ending at the prior pay-period end.

phrases: zero-headcount period;zero headcount period;headcount was zero;periods with zero headcount;zero_hc_period_seqs
description: Documentation only (from the q032 gold). A (node, pay period) of the window grid where the node has no active (status_cd = 'A') associate under the manager on the authoritative snapshot; only nodes with at least one active associate somewhere in the window are in the grid.

phrases: ISO week;ISO weeks;ISO-week;isoweek;isoweeks;same ISO week
description: Documentation only (glossary gap; from the q034 gold). An ISO week runs Monday to Sunday; a date's ISO week is DATE_TRUNC(date, ISOWEEK) (its Monday). Two dates are in the same ISO week when those Mondays are equal; not DATE_TRUNC(date, WEEK), which starts on Sunday.

phrases: tenure in ISO weeks;tenure_isoweeks;ISO weeks of tenure;ISO weeks since hire;tenure measured in ISO weeks
description: Documentation only (glossary gap; from the q034 gold). DATE_DIFF(current pay-period end, hire_dt, ISOWEEK): the number of ISO-week boundaries between the hire date (hr.employee_dim.hire_dt, glossary authoritative_hire_and_term_dates) and the current biweekly ppe_dt, later date first.
